country_code,country_name,region

caption: dbt seed creates a country_codes table with one row per CSV row.

code:
seeds:
  my_dbt_project:
    country_codes:
      +column_types:
        country_code: varchar(2)
        country_name: varchar(100)
        region: varchar(50)
caption: Inference gets ambiguous columns wrong — pin the type explicitly instead.

eyebrow: Using a seed like any model
code:
select o.order_id, o.customer_id, c.region
from {{ ref('stg_orders') }} o
left join {{ ref('country_codes') }} c
    on o.country_code = c.country_code

-- dbt seed --select country_codes
-- dbt seed --full-refresh
caption: ref() doesn't care that the upstream node started as a CSV.
